recognize_zh: 胸部電腦斷層（肺窗）軸切面，胸骨後前縱膈腔可見軟組織密度腫塊（箭頭），往左側肺野突出並推擠鄰近肺組織，對應 PET 上的高代謝病灶。
features: Axial chest CT, lung window, upper thoracic level
Lobulated soft-tissue density mass in the anterior mediastinum behind the sternum (arrow), bulging toward the left
Mass abuts the anterior aspect of the mediastinal vessels and trachea
Right apical lesion with bubbly/cavitary lucencies and mild ground-glass/interstitial markings in the right lung
Soft-tissue detail limited by lung window setting
describe_en: Axial contrast chest CT displayed in lung window demonstrates a lobulated soft-tissue mass in the anterior mediastinum (arrow), extending toward the left and abutting the anterior mediastinal structures. An additional right apical lesion with small air lucencies and subtle parenchymal opacities are present. CT localizes the mass and guides biopsy but cannot determine histology; lung window settings limit assessment of internal attenuation. In this transplant recipient the mass corresponded to EBV-positive plasmacytoma-like post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder on biopsy.
